sources.name: Ayuntamiento de Torrevieja urban bus stop inventory

transformations.description: Reuses the canonical directional StopNodes from torrevieja-v1 and projects independently captured ordered route patterns onto them. No reverse edge is inferred.
Matches A, B and C stop occurrences using route order, municipal stop name/address/direction evidence, OSM names and geographic continuity.

warnings: Line A contains both complete captured direction patterns: 22 outward and 26 return stop occurrences.
Line B contains 19 outward and 16 return stop occurrences. The source display numbering skips 12 on the return list; no synthetic stop was inserted.

Line B's C/ Nenúfares - Colegio occurrence is contextually mapped to the nearby canonical OSM node named Policía Local - Parque de Bomberos de Torrevieja - Habaneras and should be rechecked when a more explicit geocoded source becomes available.
Line C's return pattern represents the documented Hospital Quirón-serving variant; public information states that the hospital stop is not served on every circuit.
Line C's Cruz Roja occurrence maps to an unnamed canonical platform, and M. Fco. Casanovas maps to the canonical Patricio Zammit 67 node based on municipal address and route continuity.
The Ayuntamiento inventory was used as verification evidence only; no source photographs are distributed.
Review ODbL obligations before publicly distributing a derived database.
